title: The production-build freeze is NOT conditional on Cache Components
statement: Under `next build` + `next start` with Next.js 16.3.2, a Server Component reading an artifact with fs.readFileSync is prerendered as a static route and serves its build-time value regardless of whether cacheComponents is enabled or disabled; a later external write does not change what a fresh request returns in either configuration.
notes: ⚠️ THIS NARROWS AST-0010 BY WIDENING THE BEHAVIOUR. AST-0010 attributes the freeze to Cache Components, and measurement says the attribution is wrong: the disabled configuration built the same static route and served the same stale value. The claim's OUTCOME held; its CONDITIONAL FRAMING did not. That distinction matters because a reader of AST-0010 alone would conclude the risk is avoidable by turning a flag off, and it is not. ⚠️ Found only because both configurations were run. Testing the named case alone would have confirmed AST-0010 and left the wrong mitigation on the table.
